title: orchestrator · Pivot to inspecting specific benchmarks for descriptive evidence compa
summary: Pivot to inspecting specific benchmarks for descriptive evidence comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets.
body: Previous loops failed to find controlled experiments comparing dynamic consolidation against static baselines (e.g., append-only) under identical token constraints. Sources like arXiv:2609.19128v1 and GitHub:affaan-m/ECC lacked direct baseline comparisons or resource constraint matching. We must now target specific benchmarks with reproducible metrics (task success, hallucination rates) to empirically evaluate memory policies without code execution.
